title: Generic boss
text: Each preset with its own weapon type, against the generic level 63 boss (no creature type). Weapon racials count where the preset already holds that weapon type in either hand.

title: Beast target
text: A Beast boss switches on Troll Beast Slaying and Dwarf Big Game Hunter: 5% more damage.

title: Elemental target
text: An Elemental boss switches on High Order and Windshaper Elemental Insight: 5% more damage.

title: Humanoid target
text: Priests only: Dwarf Priests cast Chastise, which works on Humanoids only. No other racial cares about Humanoids, so the other presets have no Humanoid numbers here.

title: Racial weapon
text: Human, Dwarf and Orc hold their racial's weapon type (sword, mace, axe) where the class can use it and the preset holds none. A weapon racial counts while either hand holds its type, so we swap one weapon: the one whose speed changes least, or the off hand on a tie. Dagger Rogues keep the main hand dagger. The new weapon keeps the stats and damage per second and takes the nearest speed a Phase 1 BiS weapon of that type has. Casters move the staff's stats to a one-hand weapon. Other races keep the preset's weapons.

title: Base stats

short: The race's own Strength, Agility, Stamina, Intellect and Spirit, with every racial left out.

title: Weapon swap
text: A weapon racial only works while either hand holds its weapon type. So for a preset that holds another type, we swap one weapon to the racial's type, with the same stats and damage per second, at the nearest speed a Phase 1 BiS weapon of that type has. This piece is what the new weapon changes by itself, before its racial: the weapon's speed, and talents that give a different bonus per weapon type.
short: What holding the racial's weapon type changes by itself, before the racial: the weapon's speed, and talents that give a different bonus per weapon type.

title: Target type
text: What changes against this creature type: conditional racials, plus talents and spells that only work on some types.

title: Warrior
text: Best race: Undead on Fury; Orc on Arms and Fury 2H. Best Alliance pick on Fury: Human, 1.1% behind. The biggest racial on Fury is Undead Touch of the Grave, +32.5 DPS (3.0%). With a sword, Human comes within 0.8% on Arms. Against Beasts Troll leads Fury (+5.2% over its generic-boss DPS), 1.0% ahead of Dwarf. Against Elementals High Order and Windshaper lead Fury (+5.2% over its generic-boss DPS), 2.6% ahead of Undead.

title: Rogue

Against Elementals High Order and Windshaper lead Combat Swords (+5.0% over its generic-boss DPS), 2.9% ahead of Undead.

title: Paladin

title: Shaman

Against Beasts Dwarf leads Shadow (+5.0% over its generic-boss DPS), 0.1% ahead of Troll.
